summary_en: Upper limit expanded from ¥700M (310,000 shares, 5.86% S/O) to ¥1,100M (460,000 shares, 9.12% S/O). Execution window: 10 Feb 2026–9 Feb 2027 via Fukuoka Exchange market purchase and off-auction (立会外買付) trades. As of 31 July 2026, cumulative acquisitions under the prior authorization total 243,200 shares (¥558.3M).
title_en: Notice on Partial Amendment to Matters Concerning Acquisition of Treasury Shares (Expansion of Acquisition Frame)
translation_en_brief: On 18 August 2026, Miyazaki Taiyo Bank filed notice of an expansion to its treasury share acquisition authorization, originally approved on 9 February 2026. The issuer increased the maximum share purchase from 310,000 shares (¥700M, 5.86% of shares outstanding excluding treasury) to 460,000 shares (¥1,100M, 9.12% of S/O). The acquisition period remains unchanged at 10 February 2026 through 9 February 2027, executed via market purchases and off-auction trades on the Fukuoka Exchange. The expansion was undertaken to enable more flexible capital deployment in response to evolving business conditions. As of 31 July 2026, the bank had cumulatively acquired 243,200 shares for ¥558.3M under the prior authorization. The filing notes that partial acquisitions may not occur depending on investment opportunities and market conditions.
